d:
Endie ke sahyogi dal hone ke nate chhah siten upendr kushvaha ki parti rashtriy lok morcha ke khate men bhi gaee hain.
Upendr kushvaha ne in chhah siton men se ek sit par apni patni snehalta ko ummidvar banaya hai. vah sasaram se chunav lar rahi hain aur parti ki iklauti mahila ummidvar bhi hain. bibisi sanvaddata rajnish kumar ne unse unke rajniti men aane ke faisle aur bihar ki rajniti ko lekar kaee saval kie.
Vidiyo: devesh chopra
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
